source.authority: Deployed gh-pages commit 48481aba (2025-12-15), built by the Jekyll deploy workflow from main@191e416b.
source.liveChecks: https://thisismypattern.com checked on 2026-10-27: home, article, feed, sitemap and resume JSON return 200; /_pages/policies/, /blog/page/2/ and /blog/2025/ return 404.
source.gaps: A fresh local Jekyll build was not possible (missing gems from Gemfile.lock, ImageMagick not installed). Local _site is a stale development build for http://0.0.0.0:8080 with the same file list as gh-pages minus CNAME and assets/json.
source.pagesSource: Deploy workflow pushes the built folder to the gh-pages branch with JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action on push to main/master. The Pages API needs authentication and was not read; gh-pages is assumed to be the configured source. The deployed branch has CNAME but no .nojekyll.

excluded./_pages/policies/: Navigation dropdown artefact; already 404 on the live site because Pages' Jekyll ignores underscore folders.
excluded./assets/img/**/*-{480,800,1400}.webp: Responsive variants generated by jekyll-imagemagick and referenced only from generated srcset attributes.
excluded./assets/img/rhino*, /assets/img/template: al-folio template files referenced only by template documentation (INSTALL.md, FAQ.md).
excluded./requirements.txt: Python build dependency list copied into the output by mistake.
excluded./assets/js/**, /assets/css/**, /assets/f: Theme scripts, styles and fonts; not content.

post.title: Kickstarting Your Startup with DevOps from Day Zero – Part 1
